excerpt: Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols
Copy directories into the Files app Working Copy location. If the directory does not contain a .git subdirectory at top-level, Working Copy assumes you want a new repository
File content is shown with syntax highlighting for sourcecode and a preview of html and document files.
When you have file modifications the Changes tab lights up... you can commit them to the repository with a button on the Status tab.
includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence. These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI
You can configure repositories to Rebase instead of Merge commits from the Configuration page inside Repository status.
A faster solution is to use the Resolve tool that lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once.
SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.
Working Copy supports private instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea.
Regular expression search is supported for the file scope by wrapping your pattern in slashes such as /[0-9]+/
Image changes can be viewed in a split-mode where zooming one image will make the other one follow - making it easy to focus on the details.
Tap Annotate to draw freehand with Apple Pencil or your finger, or select text to highlight, underline, strike through or add a note.
The preview reloads automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes, restoring scroll and zoom
Swipe left on any commit in the repository's commit list to Checkout an old version.
For commits not yet pushed to a remote, swipe left to Undo them. The commit's changes remain in your working directory as modified files
To make changes to the latest commit enable Amend at the top of the commit dialog.
Long tapping commits you can Delete Commit to rewrite the branch without the work contributed by this single commit, Edit Message to change a commit message... or Squash a commit with its child.
To explore repository changes across branches use the Commit Graph available from the Repository screen.
Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab.
You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.
View the list of tags from the Repository status screen creating new tags by tapping + in the upper right corner.
You Stash and Unstash from the context menu of repositories.
Git submodules allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository, keeping their histories separate.
All repositories in Working Copy can be accessed in the Files app and 3rd party applications using the document picker or file browser components.
Drag files from your emails, the Files app or any other supporting app to add to your repositories.
When adding repositories you tap Link external directory and pick a folder or Document Package in the Files app.
a good way to get files into and out of Working Copy is the built-in WebDAV server.
Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.
Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
I have been using this iOS git tool to write a book - the text is on GitHub, and I just wanted to pull, edit and push while on a commute.
Today I logged in and got presented with a 'sorry: you bought the pro version, but... you need to transfer your data to the free version with in-app purchases.'

The app knew it was mid-merge and verified my purchase, triggered the other app to begin a data swap, transferred some files and marked itself to be deleted with a new icon. It was far less painful than I suspected.
Someone (I think a one-man band) took the time to develop something that took some pain away from his users, and it was noticed.
Pretty handy - assuming OP is the author, can you say what's different when compared to GitMongo? It's what I'm using now.
I ended up not wanting to put my years of thinking, planning and researching up on a public service, so I spun up a $5/month VPS instance from AWS Lightsail to be a dedicated git server.

So now you are putting all your eggs in one basket and you have the headache of this AWS service and any changes AMZN wants to make to that service. The beauty of git is that you can have multiple remotes and push to all of those remotes.
